title: Bytes compared with a String decode in the field's encoding
description: IHDR bytes equal 'IHDR'; C3 A9 decodes as UTF-8 by default and E9 as the field's ISO-8859-1; a malformed byte decodes to U+FFFD; two Bytes values compare byte for byte; len() of Bytes counts bytes; trim() and concat() accept Bytes as a String.
